BiblicalUsage: Jorkoam is named once, in 1 Chronicles 2:44. In 1 Chronicles 2:44, the record says, "And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai."
TheologicalSignificance: Jorkoam belongs in the geography of Scripture, and my position is that the small places matter too.
